operators.name: custom_group_norm
semantics: Applies group normalization over the channel dimension: each group has num_channels/num_groups channels.
Computes mean and variance per group over spatial dimensions (length) and across channels in the group, as in F.group_norm with no weight/bias and default eps=1e-5.
Normalizes each group using (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and layout.
No learnable affine parameters used (weight=None, bias=None).

operators.name: custom_conv_transpose1d
semantics: Performs 1D transposed convolution (also called deconvolution) with the given weight and bias.
Input x has shape [batch, num_channels, length_in].
Weight shape [num_channels, out_channels, kernel_size].
Output length = (length_in-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding.
Uses cuDNN implementation (as ConvTranspose1d does under the hood).
Bias is added per output channel if provided; if None, no bias is added.
Supports arbitrary strides on input tensor, does not assume contiguity.
Preserves float32, CUDA device.
Applies group normalization over the channel dimension with groups=self.num_groups=4.
Input shape [128, 16, 8192]; normalized across each group of 4 channels and all 8192 spatial positions.
Computes per-group mean and variance (unbiased variance is not used; torch uses biased variance in normalization), then normalizes with eps=1e-5.
No affine parameters (weight=None, bias=None).
Output shape identical to input: [128, 16, 8192], dtype float32, device cuda.
Applies ConvTranspose1d with in_channels=16, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1, bias=True.
Input shape [128, 16, 8192].
Weight shape [16, 32, 3], bias shape [32].
Output shape [128, 32, 16384], dtype float32, device cuda.
Returns tensor, exactly as the nn.Module forward.
Returns the output tensor from step_002 directly.
Final output shape [128, 32, 16384], dtype float32, device cuda.
